verification_statement: Every item is provenance.verified = false. The section pairs were checked against official government sources in this environment, but that is a machine-assisted source check, not human legal approval. No item has been approved by a qualified legal reviewer.

correctness_classes.reason: correctness is measured by the judge against gold from generated samples (jurisuq/pipeline.py, majority_correct); it is not an authored field, so authoring one would fabricate the measurement G7 depends on

murder.punishment: death or imprisonment for life, and fine
murder.note: BNS 103(1) carries IPC 302 verbatim; BNS 103(2) (group murder on protected grounds) is new and has no IPC counterpart.

culpable_homicide.bns_label: punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
culpable_homicide.ipc_label: punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
culpable_homicide.punishment: see BNS 105(1)-(2); the graduated terms are cited, not reproduced
culpable_homicide.note: BNS 100 (culpable homicide) and 101 (murder) restate IPC 299 and 300. BNS 105(1) is read as the successor of IPC 304, supported here by the official arrangement-of-sections titles. The sub-section terms differ from IPC 304 in detail and are NOT reproduced in this dataset.

theft.punishment: up to three years, or fine, or both; separate tiers for repeat conviction and for low-value first offences
theft.note: BNS 303(1) is the theft definition (IPC 378); 303(2) is the punishment. The community-service proviso has no IPC counterpart.

theft_in_dwelling.bns_label: theft in a dwelling house, or means of transportation or place of worship
theft_in_dwelling.punishment: not reproduced here; BNS 305 is subdivided and the added sub-sections have no IPC counterpart
theft_in_dwelling.note: BNS 305 enlarges IPC 380 to cover means of transportation and places of worship, and adds new sub-sections (b)-(e).

criminal_breach_of_trust.bns_label: punishment for criminal breach of trust
criminal_breach_of_trust.ipc_label: punishment for criminal breach of trust
criminal_breach_of_trust.punishment: up to five years, or fine, or both (raised from three years under IPC 406)
criminal_breach_of_trust.note: BNS 316 consolidates IPC 405-409 into one section; the general punishment in 316(2) is read as the successor of IPC 406. The aggregated structure means the IPC 406/407/408/409 distinctions are partly lost, which is recorded as a limitation.

cheating.bns_label: cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
cheating.ipc_label: cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
cheating.punishment: up to seven years, and fine
cheating.note: BNS 318(1) is the cheating definition (IPC 415); 318(2)-(4) carry IPC 417, 418 and 420. The 318(4) <- 420 pairing is standard but the UP Police excerpt read here showed only 318(1)-(3).

wrongful_restraint.punishment: up to one month, or fine up to five thousand rupees, or both
wrongful_restraint.note: BNS 126(1) is wrongful restraint (IPC 339); 126(2) is the punishment (IPC 341). The fine ceiling rose from five hundred to five thousand rupees.

cruelty_by_husband.bns_label: husband or relative of husband subjecting a woman to cruelty
cruelty_by_husband.ipc_label: husband or relative of husband subjecting a woman to cruelty
cruelty_by_husband.punishment: up to three years, and fine
cruelty_by_husband.note: BNS 85 and 86 correspond to IPC 498A and its Explanation. The official correspondence table was read only up to Chapter V here, so this pair rests on the BNS titles plus the standard published mapping and needs human confirmation.
